abstract: PURPOSE: To establish guidelines to determine the normal size of pelvic lymph nodes by correlating computed tomographic (CT) and lymphangiographic data. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Forty men in whom stage I testicular tumors were being treated underwent CT scanning 3-4 months after undergoing lymphangiography. The site, size, and number of nodes at CT scanning were documented. Maximum short-axis diameter (MSAD) was measured at four anatomic sites in the pelvis. Results were analyzed with histograms, and median and percentile values were calculated. RESULTS: There were 187 nodes measured in 27 men before lymphangiography. There were 1,801 nodes measured in 40 patients after lymphangiography. Median MSAD values at CT after lymphangiography were 5 mm or less; fewer than 2% of nodes had an MSAD greater than 10 mm. CONCLUSION: Almost all normal pelvic nodes are less than 10 mm MSAD, depending on the site. The low sensitivity of CT in depicting metastases to the pelvic lymph nodes might be improved by adopting upper limits of normal that reflect this size.

PURPOSE: 骨盤リンパ節の正常サイズの基準を確立するため、CTとリンパ管造影のデータを相関させる。
MATERIALS AND METHODS: 病期I精巣腫瘍の治療を受けている男性40例が、リンパ管造影の3〜4か月後にCTを受けた。リンパ節の部位、サイズ、個数をCTで記録した。骨盤の4つの解剖学的部位で最大短径(MSAD)を測定した。結果はヒストグラムで解析し、中央値と百分位数を算出した。
RESULTS: リンパ管造影前の27例で187個のリンパ節を、リンパ管造影後の40例で1,801個のリンパ節を測定した。リンパ管造影後のCTでのMSADの中央値は5mm以下であり、10mmを超える節は2%未満であった。
CONCLUSION: ほぼすべての正常骨盤リンパ節はMSADが10mm未満であり、部位によって異なる。骨盤リンパ節への転移を描出するCTの感度が低いことは、この正常上限値を採用することで改善される可能性がある。
